observations: Photos 0 to 2: one automatic gearbox lying on bare dirt in an open yard, bell housing at the top, with a transfer case bolted to the rear, so a 4WD unit for a longitudinal engine.
Cooler lines, wiring harness and a loose purple connector hang off the case; an output flange stub sticks out of the transfer case.
Case is heavily coated in oil and dust; no clean area showing fresh seals or an undisturbed pan.
No identification tag, part number or casting text is legible in any photo; no torque converter is visible in the bell housing.
Another gearbox sits under a tarpaulin beside it; all photos carry a GEARUP INC dealer watermark posted on Jiji.
No photo of the pan, fluid, ID tag, or any running or shifting clip.

identity.kind: automatic gearbox with 4WD transfer case (seller says Ford Expedition V8)
read_from: photos 0 to 2 show the gearbox and transfer case shape only; no tag or code legible

claims.evidence: Shape fits a longitudinal 4WD automatic with transfer case, but no ID tag or part number is readable to tie it to an Expedition.
Photos 0 to 2 show a transfer case bolted behind the gearbox.
Origin cannot be shown by photos; no import paper shown.
No clip of it running or shifting through gears in a vehicle.
No donor car odometer shown; the case is heavily oil and dust coated.
No close-up of pan bolts, pan gasket or case seams.

risks.risk: Gearbox and transfer case are not the Expedition V8 units claimed (wrong model or year fitment)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the transmission ID tag or stamped part number and the transfer case tag
risks.if_unproven: cannot be matched to comparables; identity must be read first

risks.risk: Slipping, harsh shifting or failed solenoids
risks.proof: Clip of it fitted in a car, shifting through all gears and reverse, with dash visible
risks.if_unproven: as not working, core value only

risks.risk: Burnt fluid or internal wear, previously opened
risks.proof: Photo of the fluid on a white cloth and close-up of pan, pan bolts and seams

risks.risk: Transfer case 4WD engagement faulty or electric shift motor missing
risks.proof: Close-up of the transfer case shift motor and a clip of 4WD engaging
risks.if_unproven: as 2WD gearbox with faulty transfer case

risks.proof: Photo looking into the bell housing showing the converter in place

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the transmission ID tag or stamped part number, and the transfer case tag
Clip of it working in a car, shifting through all gears, reverse and 4WD
Photo into the bell housing showing whether the torque converter is included
Close-up of the oil pan, pan bolts and a fluid sample on white cloth
response.reason: It is a 4WD automatic gearbox with transfer case, but no tag or part number is readable, so the fitment that sets the price rests on the seller's word alone and needs the ID tag shot before any comparable can be chosen.
